notes.title: Achievements
notes.notes:
Dear players!

We are pleased to inform you that our update is finally available on Steam! 

To make the gameplay even more fun, we have added achievements to the game. 
They will be an additional incentive to explore the game world and complete various tasks.

We want to express our deep gratitude to everyone who supported us throughout the development of the game. Your feedback and suggestions helped us make the game better.

We wish you a pleasant time in our game!
